items.quote: 8:15 And God spake unto Noah, saying, 8:16 Go forth of the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons’ wives with thee.
items.claim: The text says God told Noah to leave the ark with his wife, his sons and his sons' wives.
items.object: Noah, his wife, his sons, and his sons' wives
items.mechanism: direct divine speech ("spake unto Noah, saying")
